about: Performance budgets (spec WP-102), checked by scripts/check-budgets.mjs after every production deploy. `weights` are exact, measured on what the page downloads: each is what the production runner measured on 2026-10-10 (after the lazy chat engine and the zod fix) plus 10-15% headroom — a ratchet: it only ever moves down, and a breach FAILS the check. `lab` are Lighthouse targets from the spec; they are noisy, so a breach only WARNS until the variance on a quiet runner is known (decision log D-027). Tighten a number by editing it here — never in code. Sprint 1c (2026-10-21, D-041): /systems, /journey and /about carry their own hero image, so their total and image budgets rose by that image (45, 40 and 42 KB — Systems' is the 39 KiB modules image that replaced the first one) and one request each; /contact's followed with its image (+30 KB, +1 request). The home page's image budget also carries the "Now building" card's screenshot (+80 KB, 2026-10-21): when the system the owner is building (or the one with the latest commit) has a live screenshot, the card shows it; that is data, not a regression, and it is bounded by one screenshot. One deliberate exception to only-down: the home page's largest image is 125 KB, not 90, from the Sprint 1b release (2026-10-20) — the hero's cover image (92.8 KiB desktop, 117 KiB phone: the phone image is sharper and fills the whole hero) is the page's largest paint on purpose (HOME-HERO-PLAN §15, D-034), and its weight is also a law in tests/integration/home-hero.test.ts. Ratchet, 2026-10-24 (D-064): after the cache and the lighter scripts (D-062–D-064) each weight is what production measured on 6a57a21, the heavier device, plus 10%. Floors (D-064, the owner's plan Phase 5) always fail: performance 78 on a phone (the lowest page measured 80) and 95 on a desktop, accessibility 90 / 95 (home on a phone measures 93 — the consent card over the page during the check), CLS 0.1. The LCP 2.5 s goal stays a warning until a phone reaches it.
